item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory Section 301 determination that the agreement is an appropriate and feasible response; the legal consequence occurs upon this determination, while the remaining text explains its basis and anticipated effects.","evidence":"I have determined that the Agreement between the Governments of Japan and the United States of America Regarding Trade in Semiconductors, to be implemented by an exchange of letters, is an appropriate and feasible response"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently determines the legal character of any future Japanese noncompliance under Section 301; the reporting instruction is internal executive oversight ancillary to that determination.","evidence":"I hereby determine that any future failure by the Government of Japan to meet the commitments and objectives of the Agreement would be inconsistent with a trade agreement or an unjustifiable act that would burden or restrict U.S. commerce"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"Although the first sentence directs discretionary implementation by the Trade Representative and Commerce Secretary, the President himself immediately suspends the Section 301 proceeding, with continuation conditioned on fulfillment of the agreement.","evidence":"the Section 301 proceeding on semiconductors shall be suspended and shall remain suspended as long as the objectives and commitments of the Agreement are fulfilled"}]}
